title: Mini Mesh FRP Grating: 12x12mm Opening Guide for Safety & Anti-Fall
author: ZeAll Team
excerpt: Mini mesh (micro mesh) FRP grating with 12x12mm or 19x19mm openings. Ideal for safety platforms, small object fall protection, and anti-slip walkways.
content:
1. What is Mini Mesh FRP Grating?

Mini mesh (also called micro mesh or small opening) FRP grating has smaller bearing bar spacing: 12x12mm or 19x19mm opening, compared to standard 38x38mm. This prevents small tools, objects or feet from falling through. Available in molded construction with 25mm, 30mm or 38mm thickness.

2. Why Use Mini Mesh?

Safety: prevents foot entrapment and small object fall-through. Food processing: prevents small parts, tools or contaminants from falling into processing equipment. Electrical: prevents tools from contacting live equipment. Maintenance platforms: no dropped bolts/wrenches reaching lower levels. Stair tread nosing: anti-slip and anti-tripping.

3. Specifications

Standard opening: 12x12mm (mini), 19x19mm (medium mini). Bar size: 5mm cross bar, 10-13mm bearing bar. Thickness: 25mm, 30mm, 38mm. Panel size: 1220x3660mm. Resin: iso polyester, vinyl ester, food-grade white. Color: yellow, grey, white, green.

4. Price Comparison

Mini mesh costs 20-35% more than standard mesh due to more fibers and labor. 25mm mini mesh: USD 45-58/m2. 38mm mini mesh: USD 62-78/m2. Despite higher cost, it eliminates the need for secondary safety grating underneath, reducing total project cost.

5. Applications

Food & beverage processing floors. Pharmaceutical clean rooms. Electrical substation platforms. Maintenance access on equipment. Stair tread covers. Trench covers where small objects must not fall through. Offshore oil rig walkways.

6. Ordering

Specify: mini mesh (12x12mm or 19x19mm), thickness, resin, surface (concave or grit), color, quantity. Email sales@gratingfrp.com. MOQ: 30m2. Lead time: 15-20 days (custom manufacturing).
